macros.name: picas
macros.doc: Print dimen converted to the nearest whole pica.

macros.name: points
macros.doc: Print dimen rounded to the nearest whole point.

macros.name: pthundredthpc
macros.doc: Print dimen in points followed by the equivalent in picas (to two decimal places).

macros.name: pttenthpc
macros.doc: Print dimen in points and tenths of a pica.
